jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Business Systems & Data
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Join the engineering team that builds the AI-native apps, agents, and tools the rest of Amplitude runs on. We are full stack, automation, integration, and data engineers delivering internal apps, data products, automations, and integrations to Finance, People Ops, Product Ops, Legal, HR, and more. We embed in each team, become experts in their business problems, partner on the solution, and accelerate time-to-value.

 

This is an AI-first, full-stack software engineering role spanning the complete scope of our team’s work. Your engineering experience and fluency with frontier AI technologies will drive continuous improvements in both the systems we build the way we build them. The sum total of this work will produce meaningful business impact on the way all of Amplitude’s critical business functions operate.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Design and build full-stack apps and tools to solve high-leverage operational use cases across the business

  • Build service connectors that enable AI and automation tools to work across business systems

  • Evolve our tools and processes to increase team velocity, simplify our technical stack and leverage new AI-native approaches

  • Drive end-to-end reconciliation across financial systems from quote to revenue recognition, enabling cross-system reporting and end-to-end traceability

  • Own what you build across the full software development lifecycle

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • 5+ years engineering experience shipping and running production services

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

  • Full-stack development experience spanning frontend, backend, tools and integrations

  • An enthusiasm for understanding new business problems, learning unfamiliar systems, delivering improvements and evolving their design incrementally

  • Experience working with data warehouses and SQL-based systems 

  • Ability to translate business problems to technical solutions and software designs

  • Experience with frontier AI tooling including harnesses, MCP servers, and agents

  • Curious and fast-learning across new domains as the work moves with the business

  • Bias for action - comfortable rapidly iterating to turn business problems into prototypes and ultimately solutions

Nice to Have

  • Experience evaluating LLM systems using eval harnesses, regression suites, and accuracy tracking over time

  • Familiarity with dbt, Snowflake, or medallion-style warehouse architecture

  • Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, Workday, Zip, Ramp, or Stripe

  • Prior work as an internal-tools, solutions, or platform engineer — where your users were internal stakeholders, not just external customers

This role is eligible for equity, benefits and other forms of compensation.

Based on Colorado law, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Colorado. Colorado range: $198,000 - $299,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in New York City, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in New York City. New York City salary range: $220,000 - $331,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in California, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in San Francisco Bay Area of California. Salary range: $220,000 - $331,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in California, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in California outside of the San Francisco Bay Area. California salary range: $198,000 - $299,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in Washington state, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Washington state. Washington salary range: $198,000 - $299,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in Washington state, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Washington only: unlimited PTO, 10 to 13 holidays annually (will vary), medical dental and vision PPO and CDHP plans. Finally, a company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.

***This hire must be based in the Pacific Standard Time (PST) or Mountain Standard Time (MST) Zone***

Amplitude is the leading AI-first digital analytics platform that helped over 4,000 customers build better products and digital experiences. Our customer base includes Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, Square, and Under Armour. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2's Fall 2025 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The Customer Success team is responsible for building relationships with and driving long-term value realization for Amplitude's customers.

The Senior Technical Success Manager owns customer deployment, adoption, and value realization across Amplitude's digital analytics platform. They bring strong product knowledge and fluency in customer technical ecosystems: data foundations, taxonomy, instrumentation patterns, and AI agent configuration. They are execution-first and outcome-driven from presales through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion.

As a Senior Technical Success Manager, Emerging Enterprise, you will:

  • Own customer deployment, adoption, and outcomes for a portfolio of 30-40 accounts, from presales through renewal

  • Lead deployment planning and implementation across your book, e.g.: scoping, deployment plan creation, kickoff meetings, use case alignment, coordination of delivery (e.g. managing internal and partner teams), project reporting

  • Track and manage risks and issues across active deployments, driving resolution before they impact timelines or outcomes

  • Monitor portfolio health through AI-augmented signals, engaging proactively to accelerate adoption, drive renewals, and deepen stakeholder engagement

  • Drive product adoption by running live working sessions, identifying new use cases to expand value over time, and showcasing new platform capabilities with a point of view on how they enable customer growth

  • Develop and maintain success plans tied to customer goals, tracking milestones and risks from onboarding through renewal

  • Build and deliver executive business reviews that connect Amplitude usage to measurable business impact, turning adoption into a renewal and expansion story

  • Partner with Account Executives on renewals and expansion, building the value story, coaching champions, and identifying growth opportunities across your book

  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, channeling product feedback, market needs, and customer priorities to shape how Amplitude builds and delivers

  • Continuously improve how you operate: develop repeatable playbooks, share best practices across the team, and find new ways to drive customer outcomes at scale

Critical Skills Profile

  • Business Acumen: Understands each customer's business model, growth levers, and priorities. Builds a path to value that connects Amplitude's platform to the outcomes that matter most to the customer.

  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable with Amplitude data architecture, instrumentation methods, taxonomy design, and AI agent workflows. Able to unlock use cases and guide internal and partner delivery teams.

  • Delivery Excellence: Drives deployment and implementation quality across a full book of business. Manages timelines, coordinates internal and partner delivery teams, and ensures every account progresses through milestones on time and to standard.

  • Ownership of Outcomes Across Portfolio: Responsible for retention across your territory. Ruthlessly prioritizes time, resources, and attention to focus on the accounts and actions that drive the most impact. Accountable for ensuring customers achieve measurable business results from Amplitude, and for connecting customer outcomes to commercial value.

  • Prescriptive Customer Guidance: Sets the standard for what good looks like at each stage of the customer journey. Drives accountability across deployment and ongoing success. Pushes back on bad implementation patterns, guides customers toward proven approaches, and holds them accountable to their own defined success criteria.

  • Diagnostic Thinking: Proactively recognizes adoption gaps and technical blockers early and drives creative solutions that get customers back on track.

  • Curiosity and Self-Sufficiency: Defaults to figuring things out independently. Explores edge cases on your own, and comes to conversations with a point of view. This role requires someone who runs toward ambiguity.

  • AI Innovation: Embeds AI in day-to-day workflow to improve efficiency and customer outcomes. Experiments, iterates, and shares best practices.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS

  • 2+ years of experience specifically leading enterprise software deployments where change management and foundational data governance were core priorities.

  • 2+ years managing a portfolio of 20+ mid-market or emerging enterprise accounts

  • Experience co-owning renewals and contributing to expansion pipeline alongside a sales counterpart

  • Experience training or enabling non-technical teams to become data-sufficient.

  • Excellent communication skills to influence everyone from a data engineer to a C-level executive.

  • Expert-level project management skills and the ability to thrive in an independent and fast-paced environment.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with digital analytics, product analytics, or adjacent data/experimentation platforms

  • Background in consulting, solutions delivery, or implementation

  • Experience using Amplitude as a practitioner

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in both principle and as a matter of policy. We will recruit, hire, train, promote, compensate and provide benefits to all applicants and employees without regard to ancestry, sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, religion, religious creed, mental and/or physical disability, medical condition, military and/or veteran’s status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all recruiting, hiring, promotions, upgrades, layoffs, compensation, benefits, terminations and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. The firm complies fully with all federal, state and local equal employment opportunity laws.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Serve as a trusted technical hand-on operator for our customers

  • Assist our customers by creating playbooks as they integrate Amplitude into additional data flows and business processes, thereby making Amplitude an integral business partner

  • Run deep-dive investigations into data discrepancies and recommend action plan

  • Audit existing Amplitude implementations against best practices — SDK version, instrumentation patterns, property naming, event-volume efficiency — and produce a scored report with prioritized remediation steps from a repeatable rubric 

  • Gather, organize, and report trends and customer insights to optimize business processes, documentation and services

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams like Amplitude's Product, Engineering, Platform Support and Technical Success Manager to streamline internal processes and improve data management experience for our customers

  • 5+ years in a technical, customer-facing data or analytics role — implementation, solutions/sales engineering, analytics engineering, or data consulting.

  • Working knowledge of CDPs and event pipelines — Segment, mParticle, RudderStack.

  • Familiarity with cloud data warehouses, especially Snowflake and BigQuery.

  • Understanding of client-side and server-side SDK instrumentation across web and mobile.

  • A solid grasp of event taxonomy design and data governance principles.

  • Able to collaborate across time zones with onshore architects and account teams.

  • At least 5 years of customer facing technical experience, with a demonstrated record of successfully engaging with enterprise accounts.

  • Execution and customer service oriented, able to effectively prioritize, project manage and complete customer deliverables on-time and drive outcomes.

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, and our ability to deliver measurable customer outcomes quickly is a key part of how we keep that lead. The Customer FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer success — owning the technical delivery that takes validated products from co-development and implements them across enterprise customers.

As a Customer Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own end-to-end technical delivery for enterprise customer implementations, from sales engagement through post-deployment validation. You'll work directly in Amplitude's product codebase, submitting PRs, shipping customer-specific solutions, and building reusable patterns that make every successive engagement faster. This is not a traditional support or solutions role. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The opportunity

We're entering a world where AI agents don't just assist product teams, they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents' ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. Our in-house OLAP engine, Nova, processes trillions of events in real time, turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for tens of thousands of agents and product teams worldwide.

 

That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova's throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

 

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who wants to go deep on the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath. You'll own significant components of a modern OLAP system, across query execution, columnar storage, distributed compute, caching, and cloud infrastructure, and drive meaningful improvements to performance, cost-efficiency, and reliability. This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of enterprise customers.

 

The Impact you will deliver

Build the next generation of Nova

  • Own core components across query execution, columnar storage, and distributed compute.

  • Design elastic query infrastructure for AI agents as first-class clients, targeting 10× query throughput with predictable performance and lower cost per query.

  • Solve deep performance problems across engine internals and cloud infrastructure, from JVM and memory optimization to distributed execution.

  • Own production reliability through on-call, incident investigation, and architectural improvements that prepare Nova for its next stage of growth.

Shape what comes next

  • Set technical direction for major initiatives and lead them from proposal through production, with clear milestones and measurable results.

  • Decide what to build, what to adopt, and how to evolve Nova for its next order of magnitude in scale.

  • Work across engineering and product to set priorities and resolve trade-offs between capabilities, complexity, and cost.

  • Help senior engineers take on larger technical problems through design reviews, debugging, and shared ownership.

Who you are

You are a systems-minded engineer who:

  1. Gets energy from working inside complex distributed systems, finding bottlenecks, and making meaningful improvements.

  2. Has built or significantly extended a query engine, storage engine, or distributed data processing system.

  3. Makes sound trade-offs across performance, cost, correctness, and reliability, and builds support for technical decisions across teams.

Helps engineers take on harder problems through design reviews and debugging, while staying open to new ideas and learning from others.

 

Requirements

  • 4+ years of industry experience in backend or infrastructure engineering, with depth in distributed data systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or extending analytical or OLAP systems: query engines, columnar storage, large-scale data processing or streaming frameworks, or equivalent.

  • Track record of leading multi-month, cross-team technical projects from design through production, including significant cost or performance wins on cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals: distributed systems (partitioning, replication, consistency, failover), data structures and algorithms, concurrency, performance optimization.

  • Demonstrated technical influence beyond your immediate team: leading design discussions, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring engineers.

  • Proficiency in Java, C++ or Python.

Nice to have

  • Experience with query or OLAP systems such as Druid, ClickHouse, Presto/Trino, Spark, BigQuery or Snowflake.

  • Experience with SQL planning and optimization, or with building SQL layers over heterogeneous storage.

  • Familiarity with open table and columnar formats (Iceberg, Parquet, Arrow, ORC) and warehouse-native architectures.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation platforms, event-driven data systems, or serving data to LLM and agent workloads.

Amplitude provides equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

About the Role & Team

Every chart, insight, and experiment result a customer sees in Amplitude passes through the compute layer that this team owns. Our team sits between Amplitude's front-end analytics products/ rest APIs/ MCPs and Nova, our proprietary analytics database, and owns the compute API that translates a user's question into a fast, correct answer.

 

Our mandate: enable a highly performant, reliable, and flexible way to compute insights. Those three goals are often in tension the more flexible we make the system, the harder it is to keep it fast and simple, and a lot of the interesting engineering work on this team lives in that tradeoff.

 

Day to day, you'll work closely with engineers on data management, marketing analytics, Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, Query, and various product teams, since they're all consumers of what we build.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will

  • Design and build core parts of the query/compute engine that powers analysis across Amplitude's product suite

  • Evolve the compute API and semantic layer that other engineering teams build features on top of, so that it can support a more generic table 

  • Help unify and evolve our core data model, including how non-event data (profile properties, lookup tables, etc.) is represented alongside event data

  • Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of query planning and execution on the Amplitude query engine

  • Partner with teams across Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, Query, and frontend to understand their needs and shape the compute layer around them

  • Take ownership of projects end-to-end, from design through rollout

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have

  • Strong backend or distributed-systems engineering experience, ideally touching OLAP databases, query engines, or data infrastructure

  • Experience with SQL, query planning/execution, or building APIs that many other engineering teams depend on

  • Comfort reasoning about tradeoffs between flexibility, performance, and ease of use and making deliberate calls between them

  • A track record of owning ambiguous, cross-team projects end-to-end rather than just executing well-scoped tickets

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; this team's work only matters in the context of the products built on top of it

Bonus points for

  • Experience with large-scale event or time-series data systems

  • Experience designing semantic layers, ORMs, or other data-modeling abstractions

  • Familiarity with columnar databases or OLAP query engines

  • Experience integrating a data platform with external tools or AI/agent workflows

Example projects you might work on

 

  • New compute schema and parallelization — redesigning how queries are represented internally to unlock faster, more parallelizable execution.

  • Deeper session-based analysis — extending our session-analysis capabilities with new filters and formula support.

  • Smarter result caching — improving both the actual and perceived speed of the query engine.

  • Extending SQL as an interface into Amplitude's data lets AI agents, third-party tools, and warehouse-native workflows query Amplitude data directly and reliably. Paving the way for us to run directly on an external warehouse. 

  • Bringing non-event data into the core model — representing things like customer profile properties, sessions, and lookup tables alongside event data, so features can be built against a single consistent model quickly and computed efficiently.

  • Data access controls,  giving enterprise admins fine-grained control over who can access sensitive data, so they can confidently expand what they send into Amplitude and who can use it.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Amplitude is moving fast, from product analytics to an AI-native platform with agents embedded across the product, used by over 4,700 companies. We are looking for a strong design leader with a builder mindset to lead a 15-person design team through the next phase of growth. 

This is a player-coach role. You manage and grow the team. You also stay in the actual work: elevating quality through feedback, pairing with designers on the hardest UX puzzles, and asking the right questions to unlock the crux of the problem. You'll know every product surface well enough to raise its quality — even if you don't own any single one end-to-end.

Designers are embedded in autonomous pods and need to keep shipping fast. Maintaining speed without compromising on coherence and quality is the job. If that tension sounds like an exciting problem to solve rather than a contradiction to complain about, keep reading.

What you'll do

Build the team. Hire, grow, and retain a high-performing design team, identifying people who will thrive and raise the bar at Amplitude. Develop them through direct, specific feedback. Help someone who's stuck get moving again.

Set direction. Drive the design strategy for Amplitude's product suite: Core Amplitude, Statsig, and Wave (a proactive agent that helps teams build self-improving products). Help define how agents and humans work together in the same workflows.

Champion craft. Strong visual design builds trust, clarity, and delight in the era of AI. Lead by example, elevating the quality of the product through exceptional design execution.

Hold a high bar. AI makes it cheap to ship UI changes, which makes it easy for quality to erode quietly. Set a clear standard for what good looks like and enforce it without becoming an approval bottleneck. 

Stay in production. You believe that “the design” is what ships. Code is the material that brings the design to life. Push on the details, the papercuts, the edge cases. 

Speak for the customer. Show up in leadership conversations as the voice of the customer, pushing for solutions that genuinely serve their needs and reduce complexity.

What we're looking for

  • You've managed senior, independent IC designers and earned their respect through product and craft judgment.

  • You've shipped products that moved real customer and business metrics, fast.

  • You've created (not inherited) structure inside of a messy, high-growth organization.

  • You've shipped AI-native experiences and use AI tools in your own practice today (we'll ask what you built and what you learned).

  • Your portfolio shows both systems-level thinking and pixel-level craft.

  • Bonus: You’ve designed for both technical and non-technical users, and can hold that tension without compromising the experience for either.

  • Bonus: Experience with Analytics, Experimentation, or Developer tools.

What this is not

  • Not an executive role that manages up and delegates down. You're deep in the work.

  • Not a pure IC role. You're accountable for a team of 15.

  • Not design ops. Your job isn't to add rituals, templates, or governance.

Not the approval committee. Pods keep moving; you create coherence without becoming the bottleneck.

What Amplitude Brings You

  • An ahead-of-the-curve AI-empowered company. People across all disciplines regularly ship code. This is a player-coach role. You manage and grow the team. You also stay in the actual work: elevating quality through feedback, pairing with designers on the hardest UX puzzles, and asking the right questions to unlock the crux of the problem. You'll know every product surface well enough to raise its quality — even if you don't own any single one end-to-end.

Designers are embedded in autonomous pods and need to keep shipping fast. Maintaining speed without compromising on coherence and quality is the job. If that tension sounds like an exciting problem to solve rather than a contradiction to complain about, keep reading.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the team. Hire, grow, and retain a high-performing design team, identifying people who will thrive and raise the bar at Amplitude. Develop them through direct, specific feedback. Help someone who's stuck get moving again.

Set direction. Drive the design strategy for Amplitude's product suite: Core Amplitude, Statsig, and Wave (a proactive agent that helps teams build self-improving products). Help define how agents and humans work together in the same workflows.

Champion craft. Strong visual design builds trust, clarity, and delight in the era of AI. Lead by example, elevating the quality of the product through exceptional design execution.

Hold a high bar. AI makes it cheap to ship UI changes, which makes it easy for quality to erode quietly. Set a clear standard for what good looks like and enforce it without becoming an approval bottleneck. 

Stay in production. You believe that “the design” is what ships. Code is the material that brings the design to life. Push on the details, the papercuts, the edge cases. 

Speak for the customer. Show up in leadership conversations as the voice of the customer, pushing for solutions that genuinely serve their needs and reduce complexity.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've managed senior, independent IC designers and earned their respect through product and craft judgment.

 - You've shipped products that moved real customer and business metrics, fast.

 - You've created (not inherited) structure inside of a messy, high-growth organization.

 - You've shipped AI-native experiences and use AI tools in your own practice today (we'll ask what you built and what you learned).

 - Your portfolio shows both systems-level thinking and pixel-level craft.

 - Bonus: You’ve designed for both technical and non-technical users, and can hold that tension without compromising the experience for either.

 - Bonus: Experience with Analytics, Experimentation, or Developer tools.


WHAT THIS IS NOT

 - Not an executive role that manages up and delegates down. You're deep in the work.

 - Not a pure IC role. You're accountable for a team of 15.

 - Not design ops. Your job isn't to add rituals, templates, or governance.

Not the approval committee. Pods keep moving; you create coherence without becoming the bottleneck.

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Amplitude, you'll be the technical quarterback for our most strategic opportunities. You'll partner with Account Executives to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals by translating product capabilities into business outcomes that matter to Product, Marketing, and Analytics leaders.

You'll lead technical discovery, architect custom proof-of-concept implementations, and serve as a trusted advisor to prospects navigating their digital analytics strategy. Your technical credibility and business acumen will directly influence the annual pipeline.

What You'll Do

Deal Execution (70% of time)

  • Lead technical evaluation phases for deals ranging from 100K to 1M+ ARR

  • Conduct deep discovery to map prospect workflows, tech stack dependencies, and decision criteria to Amplitude's differentiation

  • Design and execute hands-on proof-of-concepts that prove value within the prospect's actual data and use cases

  • Handle technical objections related to data architecture, privacy/compliance, and integration complexity

  • Present to C-level executives and translate technical capabilities into ROI narratives

Internal Collaboration (20% of time)

  • Partner with Product Management to communicate feature gaps and customer requirements that affect deal velocity

  • Work with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and technical alignment during implementation

  • Mentor junior SEs on technical positioning and demo best practices

Thought Leadership (10% of time)

  • Contribute to our competitive intelligence on tools like Google Analytics 4, Adobe Analytics, and Mixpanel

  • Develop reusable demo assets, technical content, and proof-of-concept frameworks for the broader SE team

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years in software pre-sales (SE, Sales Consulting, or technical Account Management roles)

  • You must be comfortable speaking to nuanced technical concepts and be a self-learner (examples include: Python, SQL, hyperscaler integrations, APIs, R)

  • Hands-on SQL experience: you can write joins, aggregations, and window functions to analyze behavioral data

  • Track record of closing technical evaluations in competitive enterprise deals

  • Comfort presenting technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders

Strongly Preferred

  • 2+ years working specifically with product analytics, experimentation platforms, or customer data platforms

  • Experience with event-based data models and understanding of tracking implementations

  • Familiarity with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI) and how analytics platforms integrate with them

  • Previous work in SaaS companies selling to Product, Growth, or Marketing teams

  • Understanding of regional data and data privacy implications for analytics tools

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: Ramp on Amplitude's platform, complete 3+ customer-facing demos, and contribute to 2 proof-of-concepts

  • First year: Influence closed-won ARR, maintain 70%+ technical win rate, and develop 2 reusable assets for the team

Why This Role Matters

Solutions Engineers are force multipliers at Amplitude. The deals you win don't just hit quota: they prove that product analytics drives measurable business outcomes for enterprises navigating digital transformation. You'll have direct visibility into our product roadmap, executive strategy discussions, and the ability to shape how we compete in the Toronto market.

About Amplitude

Amplitude is a leading digital analytics platform that helps companies unlock the power of their products. Almost 3,500 customers, including Atlassian, NBCUniversal, Jersey Mike's, Decathlon, and Rocket Companies, rely on Amplitude to gain self-service visibility into the entire customer journey.

Our Values:

  1. Humility
    No ego: We operate from a place of empathy & openness and seek to understand many points of view. Listen to understand. Invite help to increase impact. Recognize others' strengths.

  2. Ownership
    We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success. Solve root problems, not symptoms. Define success as Company → Team → Self. Follow through to ensure last-mile execution.

  3. Growth Mindset
    We're tenacious in the face of challenges and seek input in order to grow ourselves and others. Experiment boldly. Seek and act on feedback. Lean into discomfort.

  4. Customer Centricity
    We put the customer at the center of everything we do. Talk to customers. Understand customers' needs. Focus on customer outcomes.

Who We Are

The Product: Amplitude is a digital analytics platform—we help companies capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behavior, and take faster action. This empowers teams to build better product experiences that drive business growth. We’re super proud of what we’ve built and continue to expand: a platform that empowers companies to thrive in the digital era.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee ​M​edical, ​D​ental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), home office equipment (annual), and much more

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy Sessions and high quality physician office experience via One Medical membership (select U.S. locations only)

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer  (Query Infrastructure)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The opportunity

We're entering a world where AI agents don't just assist product teams, they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents' ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. Our in-house OLAP engine, Nova, processes trillions of events in real time, turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for tens of thousands of agents and product teams worldwide.

That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova's throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who wants to go deep on the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath. You'll own significant components of a modern OLAP system, across query execution, columnar storage, distributed compute, caching, and cloud infrastructure, and drive meaningful improvements to performance, cost-efficiency, and reliability. This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of enterprise customers.

The Impact you will deliver

Build the next generation of Nova

  • Own core components across query execution, columnar storage, and distributed compute.

  • Design elastic query infrastructure for AI agents as first-class clients, targeting 10× query throughput with predictable performance and lower cost per query.

  • Solve deep performance problems across engine internals and cloud infrastructure, from JVM and memory optimization to distributed execution.

  • Own production reliability through on-call, incident investigation, and architectural improvements that prepare Nova for its next stage of growth.

Shape what comes next

  • Set technical direction for major initiatives and lead them from proposal through production, with clear milestones and measurable results.

  • Decide what to build, what to adopt, and how to evolve Nova for its next order of magnitude in scale.

  • Work across engineering and product to set priorities and resolve trade-offs between capabilities, complexity, and cost.

  • Help senior engineers take on larger technical problems through design reviews, debugging, and shared ownership.

Who you are

You are a systems-minded engineer who:

  1. Gets energy from working inside complex distributed systems, finding bottlenecks, and making meaningful improvements.

  2. Has built or significantly extended a query engine, storage engine, or distributed data processing system.

  3. Makes sound trade-offs across performance, cost, correctness, and reliability, and builds support for technical decisions across teams.

Helps engineers take on harder problems through design reviews and debugging, while staying open to new ideas and learning from others.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of industry experience in backend or infrastructure engineering, with depth in distributed data systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or extending analytical or OLAP systems: query engines, columnar storage, large-scale data processing or streaming frameworks, or equivalent.

  • Track record of leading multi-month, cross-team technical projects from design through production, including significant cost or performance wins on cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals: distributed systems (partitioning, replication, consistency, failover), data structures and algorithms, concurrency, performance optimization.

  • Demonstrated technical influence beyond your immediate team: leading design discussions, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring engineers.

  • Proficiency in Java, C++ or Python.

Nice to have

  • Experience with query or OLAP systems such as Druid, ClickHouse, Presto/Trino, Spark, BigQuery or Snowflake.

  • Experience with SQL planning and optimization, or with building SQL layers over heterogeneous storage.

  • Familiarity with open table and columnar formats (Iceberg, Parquet, Arrow, ORC) and warehouse-native architectures.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation platforms, event-driven data systems, or serving data to LLM and agent workloads.

This role is eligible for equity, benefits and other forms of compensation.

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About The Role & Team

We’re looking for a Head of Product Marketing to define how Amplitude brings its multi-product portfolio to market. You’ll shape the narrative across our analytics platform, Statsig, and our proactive Agents—creating a clear, differentiated story while helping each product win with its target audience.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the strategy and operating model for Product Marketing while staying close to the work: shaping positioning, leading major launches, co-building AI loops to deliver customer and competitive insights, and partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

You’ll join at an important moment for the portfolio, as Amplitude expands beyond analytics and into experimentation to support the future of product development and iteration. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape the story and market, build the team, and build an AI native PMM org, you’ll feel right at home.



 As a Head of Product Marketing, you will: 

  • Define Amplitude’s product narrative and positioning: Own the overarching product marketing strategy and point of view across our multi-product portfolio, including analytics, Statsig, and proactive agents. Develop a differentiated point of view and way to bring the company’s worldview to life, staying close to how teams at all stages of maturity curve are building.

  • Lead GTM strategy for major products and launches: Partner with Product and Engineering to bring new products and capabilities to market—from positioning and messaging to launch strategy, enablement, customer proof, and adoption. Set a creative approach that caters to the audience, market, and maturity of each product.

  • Build and coach a high-performing AI native PMM function: Set the team’s priorities, operating cadence, and bar for quality while developing PMMs into stronger strategists and storytellers.

  • Turn customer and market insight into strategy: Develop a deep understanding of our customers, competitors, and market dynamics. Bring those insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM to influence the product and experiments.

 

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You’re a player-coach by nature—you can set strategy and lead a team, but you’re equally comfortable writing the positioning, building the narrative, jumping into a customer conversation, or helping shape a demo.

  • You have an AI-native mindset and a point of view on how AI is changing products. You build yourself and have a vision for how PMM should be structured around AI.

  • You’re an exceptional multi-audience storyteller. You can make a complex technical product compelling to an engineer, useful to a product leader, and strategically important to an executive.

  • You are high agency. You don’t wait for the perfect brief or a fully formed playbook; you push your team to make the first draft, test it with customers, learn quickly, and keep improving.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and change. You’re comfortable operating at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, and you know how to create clarity when the product and market are still evolving.

 

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 10+ years of product marketing experience, including significant experience leading product marketing strategy for technical, enterprise, SaaS, developer, data, or AI/ML products.

  • Experience leading and developing a product marketing team, while maintaining a strong track record as a hands-on individual contributor.

  • Demonstrated success defining product positioning, messaging, GTM strategy, and major product launches across a multi-product portfolio in complex or rapidly evolving markets.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to drive cross-functional alignment and business outcomes.

  • Strong technical product marketing experience, with the ability to quickly understand complex systems (data, analytics, AI/ML, or developer platforms), build credibility with engineering teams, and translate technical capabilities into clear, differentiated market narratives.

We’re looking for a Head of Product Marketing to define how Amplitude brings its multi-product portfolio to market. You’ll shape the narrative across our analytics platform, Statsig, and our proactive Agents—creating a clear, differentiated story while helping each product win with its target audience.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the strategy and operating model for Product Marketing while staying close to the work: shaping positioning, leading major launches, co-building AI loops to deliver customer and competitive insights, and partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

You’ll join at an important moment for the portfolio, as Amplitude expands beyond analytics and into experimentation to support the future of product development and iteration. If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape the story and market, build the team, and build an AI native PMM org, you’ll feel right at home.





 As a Head of Product Marketing, you will: 

 - Define Amplitude’s product narrative and positioning: Own the overarching product marketing strategy and point of view across our multi-product portfolio, including analytics, Statsig, and proactive agents. Develop a differentiated point of view and way to bring the company’s worldview to life, staying close to how teams at all stages of maturity curve are building.

 - Lead GTM strategy for major products and launches: Partner with Product and Engineering to bring new products and capabilities to market—from positioning and messaging to launch strategy, enablement, customer proof, and adoption. Set a creative approach that caters to the audience, market, and maturity of each product.

 - Build and coach a high-performing AI native PMM function: Set the team’s priorities, operating cadence, and bar for quality while developing PMMs into stronger strategists and storytellers.

 - Turn customer and market insight into strategy: Develop a deep understanding of our customers, competitors, and market dynamics. Bring those insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM to influence the product and experiments.

 - You’re a player-coach by nature—you can set strategy and lead a team, but you’re equally comfortable writing the positioning, building the narrative, jumping into a customer conversation, or helping shape a demo.

Statsig is building an Enterprise Engineering team for engineers who want unusually direct ownership of high-stakes customer outcomes. Like a Forward Deployed Engineering team, Enterprise Engineering works extremely close to customers and tackles the technical problems that matter most to them.

The difference is the scope of ownership. Forward Deployed Engineering is often concentrated around implementation or onboarding; Enterprise Engineering is responsible for a customer’s technical success throughout the entire customer journey. You’ll stay close as needs evolve, answering questions, investigating across the stack, identifying root causes, shipping fixes and features, and remaining accountable through resolution.

This is a software engineering role with a tight customer feedback loop. It is ideal for a pragmatic generalist, especially someone with backend or infrastructure depth who enjoys ambiguous problems, production systems, fast decisions, and immediate impact.

What you’ll do

  • Serve on the engineering front line in Unthread, our Slack aggregation and workflow layer, for key customer accounts.

  • Answer technical questions by reading the code, tracing behavior, inspecting production signals, and building a clear explanation, not by forwarding the thread.

  • Diagnose and fix bugs, then validate the outcome with the customer.

  • Design and implement product or platform features when doing so is the fastest, highest-quality way to solve the customer’s problem.

  • Act as the engineering point of contact for urgent issues in key customer accounts’ Slack channels, coordinating the response while retaining technical ownership.

  • Represent engineering in customer office hours and, for selected accounts, recurring weekly meetings.

  • Partner closely with customer-facing and product teams while maintaining crisp ownership, communication, and escalation paths.

  • Identify recurring patterns and improve tooling, documentation, observability, APIs, and product surfaces so the next issue is easier, or never occurs.

  • Help define the operating model, technical standards, and culture of a new team.

What success looks like

  • Enterprise customers get fast, technically credible responses and feel that one engineer owns the problem through the finish line.

  • A meaningful share of customer issues are resolved by Enterprise Engineering without disrupting product-team roadmaps.

  • You ship high-quality fixes and features across unfamiliar parts of the stack while preserving reliability and maintainability.

  • Recurring customer pain becomes durable product, platform, or operational improvement.

  • You earn trust with customers and internal teams through sound judgment, decisive execution, and clear communication under pressure.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong software engineering experience and the ability to contribute production-quality code in a large, evolving codebase.

  • A generalist mindset with meaningful depth in backend, distributed systems, infrastructure, data systems, or developer platforms.

  • Excellent debugging instincts: you can move from an imprecise report to a reproducible problem, root cause, and robust fix.

  • Comfort operating in production, using logs, traces, metrics, and code to reason about system behavior.

  • Bias toward action without sacrificing engineering quality; you know when to make the contained fix, when to invest in a broader solution, and when to escalate.

  • Clear, empathetic communication with both deeply technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Composure and good judgment in urgent situations.

  • Low ego and high ownership. You enjoy crossing team and system boundaries to get the right outcome.

You may be especially excited about this role if…

  • You like learning a broad codebase and becoming effective in unfamiliar systems quickly.

  • You want customer proximity because it makes you a sharper engineer and gives your work a shorter path to impact.

  • You enjoy the mix of debugging, systems thinking, product judgment, and hands-on implementation.

  • You are energized by building a new team and defining what excellent enterprise engineering looks like.

  • Join a culture that values ownership, velocity, and craft

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is looking for a Partner Solutions Architect - AWS to design practical, technically sound solutions connecting Amplitude with the data platforms our customers and partners use. As part of our Strategic Partnerships team, you’ll work with AWS and consulting partners, bringing hands-on architecture experience across AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks. A major part of your work will be authoring clear reference architectures and data flow diagrams that explain how solutions operate, their dependencies, and their limitations. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Solutions Engineering, and Professional Services to validate designs and help partners implement them successfully.

As a Partner Solutions Architect - AWS, you will:

  • Own the creation and maintenance of implementation-ready reference architectures and professional data flow diagrams, documenting system components, integrations, data movement, security boundaries, and operational dependencies.

  • Design and validate integrations connecting Amplitude with AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, drawing on hands-on experience building with these platforms.

  • Evaluate proposed solutions for technical feasibility, clearly explaining architectural tradeoffs, unsupported capabilities, failure points, and implementation constraints.

  • Enable partner architects, engineers, and consultants through technical deep dives, architecture reviews, and implementation guidance grounded in validated solution patterns.

  • Work with Product, Engineering, and customer-facing teams to resolve architectural questions, surface integration gaps, and turn proven implementations into repeatable partner offerings.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You’ve worked as a Partner Solutions Architect or Partner Engineer, helping technology or consulting partners design and deliver integrated solutions.

  • You bring experience with product analytics, customer data platforms, experimentation, or behavioral data pipelines.

  • You’ve developed reusable reference architectures, integration guides, or service methodologies adopted by other technical teams.

  • You understand the AWS partner ecosystem and have worked with partner architects or technical teams on shared customer solutions.

  • You can lead productive architecture reviews, challenge assumptions constructively, and help stakeholders make informed technical decisions.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in solutions architecture, data architecture, partner engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role. We welcome experience from internal architecture teams as well as partner-facing organizations.

  • You have deep experience personally authoring reference architectures and data flow diagrams, with clear documentation that technical teams can use to build and implement solutions.

  • You have direct experience building integrations, data pipelines, or other substantive solutions with AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, beyond using their interfaces or consuming reports.

  • You can work hands-on with APIs, SDKs, SQL, and a programming language such as Python or JavaScript to validate designs and troubleshoot integrations.

  • You can explain how a solution works, where it can fail, and why an approach may be unsuitable, grounding your recommendations in implementation experience and technical validation.

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

About The Role & Team

The Senior Marketing Analyst will be a strategic analytics partner to the Marketing organization, helping leaders understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better decisions through data. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Operations, you'll bring strong B2B SaaS analytics expertise to marketing planning, performance measurement, and business insights. You'll work closely with Marketing, GTM Analytics, Sales Analytics, Customer Success Analytics, and FP&A to connect data across the funnel and translate it into actionable recommendations. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on how Amplitude measures and drives efficient GTM growth.

 As a Senior Marketing Analyst, you will: 

  • Turn data into actionable marketing insights: Analyze marketing performance and funnel trends to identify what's working, what's not, and where we should adjust our strategy or investment.

  • Partner with Marketing leadership: Develop reporting, analysis, and recommendations that help Marketing leaders evaluate performance, set priorities, and make informed short- and long-term decisions.

  • Own marketing analytics and reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, reporting, and analytical frameworks that give Marketing teams clear visibility into performance, pipeline, productivity, and ROI.

  • Drive analytical projects from end to end: Translate ambiguous business questions into analytical approaches, conduct rigorous analysis, communicate findings clearly, and turn insights into recommendations and action.

  • Improve our data and analytics foundation: Partner with Marketing Operations and cross-functional analytics teams to improve data quality, governance, processes, and the systems that power Marketing reporting and decision-making.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You have experience working in B2B SaaS and understand how Marketing teams think about pipeline, funnel performance, marketing attribution, and ROI.

  • You are highly analytical and naturally curious, with the ability to dig into complex data, identify meaningful patterns, and connect the dots across multiple sources.

  • You are comfortable working with ambiguity and can take a loosely defined business question and independently turn it into a clear analytical approach and actionable recommendation.

  • You communicate complex analytical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences and can tailor your storytelling to the audience.

  • You enjoy partnering cross-functionally and can build strong relationships with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Analytics.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, GTM analytics, or a related analytical role, ideally within B2B SaaS.

  • You have strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets. Experience with Python, R, or similar analytical tools is a plus.

  • You have experience working with data from multiple systems and translating it into meaningful business insights.

  • You have experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting in tools such as Tableau, CRMA, or equivalent.

  • You have a strong foundation in analytical and statistical concepts, including hypothesis development, experimentation, data analysis, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • You have experience leveraging AI to drive effective analysis and understand the importance of the underlying data quality

jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer to support the scaling and ongoing evolution of our go-to-market (GTM) systems. You'll own end-to-end visibility into our Salesforce platform, from day-to-day configuration and support to long-term architecture and improvement. 

As part of our GTM Engineering team, you’ll partner with Sales, GTM Operations, Finance, Product & Engineering, and GTM leadership to deliver well-governed solutions across Salesforce and connected platforms like CPQ, NetSuite, Amplitude, and Snowflake.

What You'll Do

  • Hands-on platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, testing, upgrades, and user support

  • Maintain and optimize CPQ, pricing, quoting, and opportunity workflows to support the quote-to-cash process

  • Serve as the escalation line of support for Salesforce, handling escalated issues such as contract, entitlement, and provisioning discrepancies, driving root cause fixes

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with business stakeholders, gather requirements independently, and serve as a trusted partner for end users across the RevOps and Salesforce ecosystem.

  • Define and implement Salesforce standard operating procedures including but not limited to: field hygiene, data retention, integrations, permission sets, validation rules

  • Conduct regular system audits and health checks to proactively identify and resolve data quality issues

  • Manage pre-production and production environments, deploy changes using change sets or devops tooling, and ensure integrity of changes made to production systems.

  • Own Salesforce license allocation and forecasting, and monitor data storage against org limits

  • Build integrations, data flows, and install managed packages between Salesforce and external systems

  • Create and maintain system documentation for cross-team training, and participate in release planning, UAT, and post-deployment validation

  • Contribute as part of the GTM Engineering team to implement roadmap initiatives, working from design through testing and deployment.

  • Stay current with Salesforce platform changes and proactively recommend relevant new features or capabilities

Your First Six Months of Impact

  • Transition our reactive Salesforce support into an agent supported triage engine

  • Define a data retention strategy and identify opportunities to optimize data storage

  • Refine Salesforce RBAC for consistency across users and profiles

  • Respond to reactive CPQ questions independently

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of Salesforce administration experience, including hands-on work with Salesforce CPQ and quote-to-cash processes in a production revenue organization

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and a functional understanding of CPQ, pricing rules, and the quote-to-contract-to-order handoff

  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining Apex (triggers, classes, batch/schedulable jobs), with the ability to read, troubleshoot, and safely extend existing code

  • Foundational knowledge of other Salesforce development concepts (Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, platform limits)

  • Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party tools via native connectors, managed packages, or integration platforms

  • Strong customer service orientation, with a genuine desire to help users work through problems

  • Certified Salesforce Administrator or similar experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce certifications such as CPQ Specialist, CPQ and Billing Consultant Accredited Professional, or Platform Developer I/II

  • Experience supporting Salesforce at a global, publicly traded company under SOX compliance

  • Experience with Salesforce CI/CD and release automation (e.g. Copado, GitHub) across sandboxes and production

  • Proven ability to lead Salesforce initiatives end to end, from solution design through release management and post-deployment support

Why This Role

You'll be a key contributor to the systems that power Amplitude's revenue engine, with direct ownership over the stability and scalability of our Salesforce ecosystem. This role offers the chance to work across a modern GTM tech stack and partner closely with stakeholders across the business, all while growing your technical depth in CPQ and quote-to-cash architecture.

 

This role is eligible for equity, benefits and other forms of compensation.

Based on Colorado law, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Colorado. Colorado range: $144,000 - $216,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in New York City, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in New York City. New York City salary range: $160,000 - $240,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in California, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in San Francisco Bay Area of California. Salary range: $160,000 - $240,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in California, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in California outside of the San Francisco Bay Area. California salary range: $144,000 - $216,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in Washington state, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Washington state. Washington salary range: $144,000 - $216,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

Based on legislation in Washington state, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in Washington only: unlimited PTO, 10 to 13 holidays annually (will vary), medical dental and vision PPO and CDHP plans. Finally, a company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan.

 

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

hybrid- San Francisco, California or Vancouver, Canada

About The Role & Team

We’re looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join the Enterprise Foundation team, the group that builds the foundations enterprise customers rely on to run Amplitude at scale: permissions and access control, enterprise identity and administration, alerts, exports, and shared services.

You’ll work with our Product Manager and Designer to define, build, and ship end-to-end features and platform capabilities that make Amplitude secure, governable, and dependable for the largest organizations in the world. You’ll own your impact from shaping technical and product direction to delivering reliable, performant, and well-designed experiences.


Our engineers are customer-focused and solve complex problems where correctness and reliability matter. Because our systems sit underneath many customers and teams, we plan deliberately for reliability, migrations, support, and incident response alongside roadmap delivery. If you’re passionate about building trustworthy, enterprise-grade foundations that other teams and customers build on, we’d love to meet you.

The team’s mission is to deliver the enterprise-grade foundations (permissions, administration, governance, alerting, and shared services) that let customers confidently adopt and scale Amplitude, while driving infrastructure initiatives that strengthen and scale the platform.

As a Senior Engineer, you will:

  • Work with Product Management and Design to turn enterprise customer needs into well-scoped engineering solutions

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of projects, from design through rollout, migration, and ongoing operation

  • Design and build reliable services and APIs, with attention to security, correctness, and blast radius

  • Take part in on-call, incident response, and the long-term reliability of the systems the team owns

  • Get involved in performance optimization and scaling efforts

  • Lead the highest-leverage projects and contribute to the team’s technical direction

  • Mentor and contribute to the success of other engineers on the team

You'll be a great addition to the team if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience building and improving robust, scalable backends and developing interactive, user-facing applications

  • Understand the whole stack and flow of user-facing web applications

  • Have backend experience with application backends, microservices, and high-throughput systems

  • Have experience with, or strong interest in, authentication, authorization, permissions models, or other enterprise-grade platform capabilities

  • Have a track record of safely migrating and evolving critical systems with minimal customer impact

  • Have a strong critical thinking and problem-solving mindset with attention to detail

  • Have exceptional communication skills, adapt well to changing requirements, and have a proven track record of successful delivery

  • Can synthesize customer input and architectural knowledge to create outsized engineering impact

  • Have a constant desire to learn and grow in the field of web development

  • Have experience with CI/CD pipelines and are a strong practitioner of automated testing

  • Are familiar with the following: React, TypeScript, Python, NestJS, Temporal

  • Have interest or experience in technical leadership of an engineering team

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever.
