As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The opportunity

We're entering a world where AI agents don't just assist product teams, they ship features, run experiments, and make prioritization calls autonomously. What makes that possible is agents' ability to verify their work against real product data continuously. Our in-house OLAP engine, Nova, processes trillions of events in real time, turning raw behavioral data into fast, trustworthy answers that power decisions for tens of thousands of agents and product teams worldwide.

That makes Nova the critical infrastructure in the loop, and as non-stop agents become the main source of queries, the demand on Nova's throughput, correctness, and operational rigor grows dramatically.

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer who wants to go deep on the engine internals and the infrastructure underneath. You'll own significant components of a modern OLAP system, across query execution, columnar storage, distributed compute, caching, and cloud infrastructure, and drive meaningful improvements to performance, cost-efficiency, and reliability. This role is ideal for someone who finds real satisfaction in making a complex distributed system faster, cheaper, and more reliable — and who wants to do that work on a system that directly powers the product experience for thousands of enterprise customers.

 

The Impact you will deliver

Build the next generation of Nova

  • Own core components across query execution, columnar storage, and distributed compute.

  • Design elastic query infrastructure for AI agents as first-class clients, targeting 10× query throughput with predictable performance and lower cost per query.

  • Solve deep performance problems across engine internals and cloud infrastructure, from JVM and memory optimization to distributed execution.

  • Own production reliability through on-call, incident investigation, and architectural improvements that prepare Nova for its next stage of growth.

Shape what comes next

  • Set technical direction for major initiatives and lead them from proposal through production, with clear milestones and measurable results.

  • Decide what to build, what to adopt, and how to evolve Nova for its next order of magnitude in scale.

  • Work across engineering and product to set priorities and resolve trade-offs between capabilities, complexity, and cost.

  • Help senior engineers take on larger technical problems through design reviews, debugging, and shared ownership.

Who you are

You are a systems-minded engineer who:

  • Gets energy from working inside complex distributed systems, finding bottlenecks, and making meaningful improvements.

  • Has built or significantly extended a query engine, storage engine, or distributed data processing system.

  • Makes sound trade-offs across performance, cost, correctness, and reliability, and builds support for technical decisions across teams.

  • Helps engineers take on harder problems through design reviews and debugging, while staying open to new ideas and learning from others.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of industry experience in backend or infrastructure engineering, with depth in distributed data systems.

  • Hands-on experience building or extending analytical or OLAP systems: query engines, columnar storage, large-scale data processing or streaming frameworks, or equivalent.

  • Track record of leading multi-month, cross-team technical projects from design through production, including significant cost or performance wins on cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong computer science fundamentals: distributed systems (partitioning, replication, consistency, failover), data structures and algorithms, concurrency, performance optimization.

  • Demonstrated technical influence beyond your immediate team: leading design discussions, driving cross-team alignment, mentoring engineers.

  • Proficiency in Java, C++ or Python.

Nice to have

  • Experience with query or OLAP systems such as Druid, ClickHouse, Presto/Trino, Spark, BigQuery or Snowflake.

  • Experience with SQL planning and optimization, or with building SQL layers over heterogeneous storage.

  • Familiarity with open table and columnar formats (Iceberg, Parquet, Arrow, ORC) and warehouse-native architectures.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, experimentation platforms, event-driven data systems, or serving data to LLM and agent workloads.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is looking for a Content Lead to shape how we tell our story as we build the leading AI analytics platform. This is a player-coach opportunity where you’ll lead our content strategy and team while staying hands-on in the work, from developing high-impact narratives and editorial direction to writing, editing, and bringing ideas to life across channels.

We think about distribution first. The job isn't to produce content and then figure out where it goes, it's to start from who we need to reach and what we need them to believe, and work backwards into format, channel, and collaborator. That increasingly means new media: newsletters, podcasts, creators, and communities where our audience actually spends time, alongside the channels we own. A meaningful part of the role is building and using relationships outside Amplitude to co-create and distribute work we couldn't reach on our own.

You’ll partner closely with Product Marketing, Brand, Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and company leaders to turn complex ideas about analytics, AI, and the future of digital products into content that people actually want to read, watch, and share. We’re looking for someone who can raise the creative bar, move quickly, and build a modern content engine that combines great storytelling with AI-native ways of working.

As a Content Lead, you will:

  • Set the content strategy and editorial direction across key channels and audiences, defining the stories, themes, formats, and points of view that strengthen Amplitude’s brand and support our business.

  • Lead and develop the content team as a player-coach, providing clear direction, feedback, and mentorship while staying hands-on with high-priority content and creative projects.

  • Own distribution alongside content, working backwards from the audience and the message to decide format, channel, and partner, rather than producing content and finding a home for it afterward.

  • Build our presence in new media. Develop the relationships and the playbook for newsletters, podcasts, creator collaborations, and communities, and turn them into a repeatable distribution channel rather than one-off placements.

  • Create and lead external content partnerships. Identify and build relationships with publishers, operators, creators, and other companies to co-create and co-distribute work, including formats we haven't tried yet.

  • Create and elevate content yourself, including thought leadership, executive content, customer stories, campaign content, social, and other formats that bring Amplitude’s perspective to life.

  • Partner across the business with Product Marketing, Brand, Demand Generation, Sales, Product, and executives to turn customer insights, product innovation, and market trends into compelling stories that drive awareness and engagement.

  • Build a modern, scalable content engine, using AI and emerging tools to increase speed and creativity while maintaining a high bar for originality, accuracy, brand voice, and editorial quality.

  • Place bets and make cuts. Decide what we go all-in on with a small team, name what we're stopping, and be clear about which experiments we're running when we don't yet know the answer.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You’re a strong editor and storyteller with a sharp point of view on what makes B2B content memorable, useful, and differentiated.

  • You’ve led or mentored content talent and know how to raise the quality of a team without becoming a bottleneck for the work.

  • You have strong instincts for new media. You can tell which newsletter, podcast, or creator will actually reach the people we care about, and you know how to approach them.

  • You’re comfortable moving between strategy and execution. You can build the content plan in the morning and rewrite a headline or draft a CEO post in the afternoon.

  • You understand how to make complex technology, AI, analytics, or product concepts accessible and compelling for different audiences.

  • You push back well. When someone asks for a blog post, your first question is who's going to read it and how they'll find it.

  • You’re curious about AI and actively experiment with AI-native content workflows and tools, while knowing that good content still requires judgment, taste, original thinking, and a human point of view.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 8+ years of experience in content, editorial, content marketing, brand storytelling, or a related field, ideally within B2B technology or SaaS.

  • Experience leading, managing, or mentoring content professionals, with a track record of developing talent and raising the quality of the work.

  • Demonstrated experience building distribution through channels you don't own, media partnerships, creator or newsletter collaborations, communities, or similar.

  • A portfolio demonstrating exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling across multiple content formats and audiences.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to develop content strategies and bring complex ideas to market.

  • A track record of owning content from strategy through execution and measurement, with the ability to connect great storytelling to business outcomes.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About the Role & Team

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Equity Administration Analyst to help manage our global equity programs and deliver an accurate, seamless, and employee-friendly equity experience.

In this role, you’ll support the day-to-day administration of our global equity programs, including restricted stock units (RSUs), our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), and other equity awards. You’ll manage key activities across the equity lifecycle while ensuring transactions are accurate, timely, and compliant.

You’ll partner closely with Payroll, Finance, Legal, People, and our equity platform provider. This is a hands-on role for someone who brings strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and a knack for making complex equity topics easy to understand.

As a Senior Equity Administration Analyst, you will:

  • Manage day-to-day administration of our global equity programs, including grants, vesting, RSU releases, ESPP purchases, employee changes, and terminations.

  • Coordinate RSU releases, tax withholding, and reporting with Payroll and our equity platform provider across multiple countries.

  • Administer our ESPP, including enrollment, contributions, purchase cycles, reconciliations, and employee communications.

  • Maintain accurate equity records, perform reconciliations, and resolve discrepancies across equity, payroll, HR, and financial systems.

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close, financial reporting, audits, SOX controls, and other compliance requirements.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Analytics Compute Platform Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

San Francisco- Hybrid

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

Every chart, insight, and experiment result a customer sees in Amplitude passes through the compute layer our team owns. We sit between Amplitude’s product experiences, APIs, and MCPs and our analytics database, and we own the compute API that turns a user’s question into a fast, correct answer.

Our mandate: enable a highly performant, reliable, and flexible way to compute insights. Day to day, you’ll work with engineers on Data Management, marketing analytics, Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, and other product teams that build on what we ship, as well as with the Query team below us, whose engine we rely on.

This role is for an engineer who is hungry to grow quickly. You’ll own small-medium-complexity projects end to end in a system that is changing fast, and we’ll stretch you on purpose with real problems, honest feedback, and strong engineers to learn from.

WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE:

  • Make new behavioral insights easier to build. Design and ship new query capabilities, extension points, and shared libraries/services that let product teams deliver new analyses in less time.

  • Own the reliability of what you build. Define tests, rollout plans, and observability, know your service’s SLOs, and fix problems at the root.

  • Keep real customer workloads fast. Profile query paths, find bottlenecks with traces and experiments, and verify that your changes helped.

  • Help us change the system safely. Take part in migrations of APIs, schemas, and services, and learn how good abstractions make change cheaper.

  • Become a go-to person. Build real expertise in part of the system, answer teammates’ questions, and share what you learn through docs and demos.

  • Stay close to the customer. Understand the customer problem behind every project, measure whether your work made their experience better, and bring what you learn back to the team.

EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU MIGHT WORK ON:

  • Extend the compute API so a new kind of behavioral question can be expressed.

  • Propose and Move a set of query paths onto a new internal representation, with parity testing and a safe rollout so that future improvements can be done safely.

  • Add observability and SLO tracking to a part of the compute layer that doesn’t have it yet.

  • Profile and speed up a slow query pattern reported by a product team.

SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING:

  • Backend engineering fundamentals: You have 2–4 years of experience building and running production services. You write clear, tested code and can reason about failure, retries, and correctness in data-intensive systems.

  • Thoughtful problem-solving: You start by understanding the context, decompose tricky problems, and work toward a clean solution. You ask clarifying questions before diving in.

  • Ownership of quality: You instrument your code, verify outcomes before calling work done, and respond quickly when something you shipped breaks.

  • Clear communication: You flag risks early, explain decisions in writing and in conversation, and give and receive feedback openly.

  • Customer curiosity: You ask what problem a customer is trying to solve before you start building. You use Amplitude yourself, can explain it to others, and care whether the feature you shipped made someone’s work better.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering: You use AI to speed up learning, exploration, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.

  • A habit of learning and improving: You seek out feedback, act on it, and can point to specific things you got better at recently. You’re curious about how the system works around the layers you’re working on.

NICE TO HAVES:

  • Experience with query engines, columnar or analytical databases, or large-scale data processing.

  • Experience with observability, SLOs, and oncall for a production service.

  • Side projects, writing, or talks that show you learn in public.

HOW WE WORK:

  • Ship fast. We create clarity in ambiguity through action. We favor prototypes, MVPs, and incremental milestones over long planning cycles, and we escalate when a decision is stuck.

  • Value impact over effort. We tie every initiative to team, organization, and company goals, and we reshape or stop work when the expected impact no longer justifies it.

  • Company > team > me. We make decisions for the whole organization, share credit generously, and invest in the growth of the engineers around us.

  • Take responsibility. We set and meet measurable quality bars, own our SLOs, and build a no-blame culture where failures turn into organizational learning.

  • Own the product experience. We treat customer success as our job, not the job of the teams in front of us.

#LI-hybrid

Equal Employment Opportunity and Diversity Statement

We are committed to equal employment opportunity in both principle and as a matter of policy. We will recruit, hire, train, promote, compensate and provide benefits to all applicants and employees without regard to ancestry, sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, religion, religious creed, mental and/or physical disability, medical condition, military and/or veteran’s status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all recruiting, hiring, promotions, upgrades, layoffs, compensation, benefits, terminations and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. The firm complies fully with all federal, state and local equal employment opportunity laws.

Our mandate: enable a highly performant, reliable, and flexible way to compute insights. Day to day, you’ll work with engineers on Data Management, marketing analytics, Session Replay, Experiment, CDP, and other product teams that build on what we ship, as well as with the Query team below us, whose engine we rely on.



This role is for an engineer who is hungry to grow quickly. You’ll own small-medium-complexity projects end to end in a system that is changing fast, and we’ll stretch you on purpose with real problems, honest feedback, and strong engineers to learn from.





WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE:



 - Make new behavioral insights easier to build. Design and ship new query capabilities, extension points, and shared libraries/services that let product teams deliver new analyses in less time.

 - Own the reliability of what you build. Define tests, rollout plans, and observability, know your service’s SLOs, and fix problems at the root.

 - Keep real customer workloads fast. Profile query paths, find bottlenecks with traces and experiments, and verify that your changes helped.

 - Help us change the system safely. Take part in migrations of APIs, schemas, and services, and learn how good abstractions make change cheaper.

 - Become a go-to person. Build real expertise in part of the system, answer teammates’ questions, and share what you learn through docs and demos.

 - Stay close to the customer. Understand the customer problem behind every project, measure whether your work made their experience better, and bring what you learn back to the team.



EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU MIGHT WORK ON:



 - Extend the compute API so a new kind of behavioral question can be expressed.

 - Propose and Move a set of query paths onto a new internal representation, with parity testing and a safe rollout so that future improvements can be done safely.

 - Add observability and SLO tracking to a part of the compute layer that doesn’t have it yet.

 - Profile and speed up a slow query pattern reported by a product team.



SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING:



 - Backend engineering fundamentals: You have 2–4 years of experience building and running production services. You write clear, tested code and can reason about failure, retries, and correctness in data-intensive systems.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: You start by understanding the context, decompose tricky problems, and work toward a clean solution. You ask clarifying questions before diving in.

 - Ownership of quality: You instrument your code, verify outcomes before calling work done, and respond quickly when something you shipped breaks.

 - Clear communication: You flag risks early, explain decisions in writing and in conversation, and give and receive feedback openly.

 - Customer curiosity: You ask what problem a customer is trying to solve before you start building. You use Amplitude yourself, can explain it to others, and care whether the feature you shipped made someone’s work better.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering: You use AI to speed up learning, exploration, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.

 - A habit of learning and improving: You seek out feedback, act on it, and can point to specific things you got better at recently. You’re curious about how the system works around the layers you’re working on.



NICE TO HAVES:



 - Experience with query engines, columnar or analytical databases, or large-scale data processing.

 - Experience with observability, SLOs, and oncall for a production service.

 - Side projects, writing, or talks that show you learn in public.



HOW WE WORK:



 - Ship fast. We create clarity in ambiguity through action. We favor prototypes, MVPs, and incremental milestones over long planning cycles, and we escalate when a decision is stuck.

 - Value impact over effort. We tie every initiative to team, organization, and company goals, and we reshape or stop work when the expected impact no longer justifies it.

 - Company > team > me. We make decisions for the whole organization, share credit generously, and invest in the growth of the engineers around us.

 - Take responsibility. We set and meet measurable quality bars, own our SLOs, and build a no-blame culture where failures turn into organizational learning.

 - Own the product experience. We treat customer success as our job, not the job of the teams in front of us.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Data Infrastructure team within Statsig Experiment at Amplitude. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, data engineers, and data scientists responsible for the systems that power experimentation at scale.

The team owns three critical areas:

  • Data ingestion: Collecting and importing experiment exposures, custom events, OpenTelemetry data, and real user monitoring data across SDKs, streaming systems, cloud storage, and customer data warehouses.

  • Data computation: Building distributed computation systems that transform raw data into accurate, timely experiment results.

  • Stats engine: Developing and productionizing the statistical methods that help customers make trustworthy decisions from their experiments.

You will help set our technical and scientific direction, translating new statistical methods and machine learning research into capabilities that customers can use reliably at scale.

You’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and customers to advance the state of experimentation. The ideal candidate is well versed in distributed computation architectures with familiarity using or building experimentation platforms.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and grow the team responsible for Statsig’s data ingestion, experiment computation, and stats engine.

  • Define the technical and scientific strategy for advancing experimentation across both Statsig Cloud and warehouse-native deployments.

  • Partner with data scientists and engineers to turn new statistical and causal inference methods into scalable, reliable product capabilities.

  • Evolve our data and computation architecture to support increasingly complex experiment designs, metrics, and customer datasets.

  • Engage with customers to understand their experimentation challenges and translate them into platform and methodology improvements.

You’ll Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have

  • Experience leading teams (5-10 team members) that build and productionize statistically rigorous, data-intensive products.

  • Familiarity with experimentation methods such as variance reduction, sequential testing, Bayesian inference, causal effects modeling, or heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Experience building large-scale data ingestion and distributed computation systems across cloud and data warehouse environments.

  • The ability to connect statistical innovation, data architecture, and customer needs to define a compelling experimentation roadmap.

Particularly Valuable Experience

  • An advanced degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, or another quantitative field.

  • Experience with experimentation platforms, feature management systems, product analytics, or machine learning infrastructure.

  • Experience building warehouse-native products or executing computation within Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or similar environments.

  • Experience supporting experimentation for large-scale consumer products, B2B products, marketplaces, social networks, or other settings with complex units of analysis.

Why This Role Matters

Experimentation platforms cannot advance through infrastructure work or statistical research alone. New methodologies only create value when they can be implemented correctly, computed efficiently, and delivered through systems customers can trust.

This leader will bring those disciplines together. You will help build the data and computation foundation for Statsig while creating an environment where new data science innovations can move from research and prototypes into production—advancing both our product and the broader field of experimentation.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce (CPQ experience strongly preferred) and comfort working with data and complex deal scenarios

  • Familiarity with channel selling model and transacting through cloud marketplaces

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

The Opportunity: We are looking to thoughtfully expand our Enterprise team. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will act as a strategic partner to our largest prospective clients, helping them solve complex data challenges. You will work closely with leadership (including our VP of Enterprise Sales) to foster long-term relationships and build a sustainable, high-growth territory.

What You Will Do

  • Lead a Strategic Territory: Design and lead a comprehensive strategy, identifying key opportunities to introduce Amplitude to new enterprise businesses.

  • Orchestrate Complex Sales Cycles: Manage the end-to-end partnership process, navigating various lines of business (Product, Engineering, Marketing) to align stakeholders on a shared vision.

  • Nurture Client Partnerships: Move beyond transactional selling to become a trusted advisor. You will conduct discovery, present customized solutions, and guide customers toward high-impact outcomes.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work as part of an ecosystem—partnering with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Leadership to ensure our customers succeed.

  • Achieve Growth Goals: Consistently meet and exceed revenue goals by solving real problems for our customers.

You’ll Be a Great Addition if...

  • You are experienced at scale: You have successfully partnered with large, complex organizations (typically 1,500+ employees and $50M+ in revenue) and have a track record of driving significant revenue impact (generating >$1M in ARR).

  • Develop and maintain success plans tied to customer goals, tracking milestones and risks from onboarding through renewal

  • Business Acumen: Understands each customer's business model, growth levers, and priorities. Builds a path to value that connects Amplitude's platform to the outcomes that matter most to the customer.

  • Delivery Excellence: Drives deployment and implementation quality across a full book of business. Manages timelines, coordinates internal and partner delivery teams, and ensures every account progresses through milestones on time and to standard.

  • Ownership of Outcomes Across Portfolio: Responsible for retention across your territory. Ruthlessly prioritizes time, resources, and attention to focus on the accounts and actions that drive the most impact. Accountable for ensuring customers achieve measurable business results from Amplitude, and for connecting customer outcomes to commercial value.

  • Prescriptive Customer Guidance: Sets the standard for what good looks like at each stage of the customer journey. Drives accountability across deployment and ongoing success. Pushes back on bad implementation patterns, guides customers toward proven approaches, and holds them accountable to their own defined success criteria.

  • Diagnostic Thinking: Proactively recognizes adoption gaps and technical blockers early and drives creative solutions that get customers back on track.

  • Curiosity and Self-Sufficiency: Defaults to figuring things out independently. Explores edge cases on your own, and comes to conversations with a point of view. This role requires someone who runs toward ambiguity.

  • AI Innovation: Embeds AI in day-to-day workflow to improve efficiency and customer outcomes. Experiments, iterates, and shares best practices.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS

  • 2+ years of experience specifically leading enterprise software deployments where change management and foundational data governance were core priorities.

  • 2+ years managing a portfolio of 20+ mid-market or emerging enterprise accounts

  • Experience co-owning renewals and contributing to expansion pipeline alongside a sales counterpart

  • Experience training or enabling non-technical teams to become data-sufficient.

  • Excellent communication skills to influence everyone from a data engineer to a C-level executive.

  • Expert-level project management skills and the ability to thrive in an independent and fast-paced environment.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience with digital analytics, product analytics, or adjacent data/experimentation platforms

  • Background in consulting, solutions delivery, or implementation

  • Experience using Amplitude as a practitioner

Own projects from brief through publication and activation, working with channel owners to reach the right audiences. Amplitude is hiring a Head of Global Total Rewards, reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), to own our compensation programs and global benefits portfolio. Amplitude is a leading digital analytics platform that helps companies understand how customers use their products and act on those insights, and our People team attracts, rewards, and retains the talent that builds it. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with regular partnership with the CEO, CFO, General Counsel, and other executives, serving as a trusted advisor to the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors. You’ll design and run a total rewards strategy that is competitive, financially disciplined, legally sound, and fair, while ensuring employees around the world understand and value our programs.

As a Head of Global Total Rewards, you will:

  • Own global compensation strategy and programs: Set and evolve our compensation philosophy, pay structures, salary bands, leveling, and job architecture, using market benchmarking to keep programs current across geographies. Design and administer equity programs, including RSUs, stock options, ESPP, and new-hire and retention grants, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and our equity plan administrator. Advise on offers and retention situations, own pay equity analysis and remediation, and ensure compliance with applicable compensation regulations.

  • Lead compensation planning and employee enablement: Own annual and midyear compensation cycles, including manager training, compensation planning tools in partnership with People Systems, and budget alignment with Finance. Partner closely with People Business Partners to support business needs and effective global administration, and drive employee communications that build transparency and understanding of our total rewards programs.

  • Partner with executives and the Compensation Committee: Serve as the primary People team contact for Committee materials, preparing analyses, recommendations, and decks and supporting the CHRO in presenting them. Lead executive and director compensation recommendations, peer-group selection, pay-for-performance analysis, and equity burn and dilution modeling. Partner with Finance on compensation budgets, headcount cost forecasting, equity expense, and share pool planning, and with Legal on proxy and SEC disclosure inputs, plan documents, and governance requirements.

  • Lead global benefits end to end: Own the strategy, design, vendor management, and delivery of health and wellness, retirement and savings, leave and time off, mental health and family support, and perks. Lead renewals and open enrollment, including broker and carrier selection, financial modeling, funding strategy, and contract negotiation. Oversee administration, vendor performance, data integrity, employee support, and compliance with ERISA, ACA, COBRA, 401(k), and local statutory requirements. Use utilization, cost trends, and employee feedback to improve value and control costs, and drive retirement plan committee requirements and quarterly meetings.

  • Build and run the Total Rewards function: Lead and develop the team, manage external partners and advisors, and establish clear processes, controls, and audit-ready documentation across compensation and benefits. Translate complex data into clear recommendations for executive and Board decisions, and serve as a thought partner to the CHRO on workforce planning, retention, and the overall employee value proposition.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • Experience connecting sales compensation to business performance: You’ve partnered with Sales and Finance in a SaaS go-to-market organization and understand how incentive design can support revenue goals, reinforce the right behaviors, and align with the broader compensation philosophy.

  • Experience scaling Total Rewards after an IPO: You’ve helped programs evolve with the demands of a public company, strengthening compensation practices, equity planning, governance, and controls while keeping programs practical for managers and meaningful to employees.

  • Experience guiding rewards programs through growth and change: You’ve supported international expansion or M&A integration, navigating differences in compensation structures, benefits offerings, and local requirements. You bring thoughtful judgment about where global consistency adds value and where local flexibility is needed.

  • Strong systems and analytical capabilities: You’re proficient with HRIS and compensation planning tools, such as Workday, and bring advanced Excel or SQL skills. You know how to turn complex data into useful insights, improve planning and administration, and make recommendations that leaders can confidently act on.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You bring 12+ years of progressive Total Rewards experience, including 5+ years leading a team, ideally at a high-growth, publicly traded software or technology company. You’ve demonstrated the ability to develop teams, drive change, and balance rigor with speed.

  • You have deep expertise in compensation design, equity programs, and executive compensation, including direct experience preparing materials for and presenting to a Compensation Committee. You can advise executives and Board members, handle confidential matters with discretion, and push back with data when needed.

  • You have hands-on experience running global benefits programs across the US and international markets, including broker, carrier, and vendor management.

  • You bring strong financial and analytical skills, including building cost models, equity burn and dilution analyses, and budget forecasts, and explaining your recommendations to a CFO.

  • You have working knowledge of US and international compensation and benefits regulations, public company governance, and SEC disclosure requirements.

About the role

Amplitude helps companies understand how people use their digital products, and act on what they learn. As a Senior Sales Engineer based in Singapore, you'll be the technical lead in our sales conversations across Singapore and the Rest of Asia region.

You'll partner with Account Executives to win new customers and grow existing ones. Day to day, that means running discovery with product, data and engineering teams, building demos that show Amplitude working in a customer's world, and explaining to technical buyers how it fits into their stack and what it will be worth to them.

This is a hands-on role. More and more of our customer conversations are about how Amplitude connects to a data warehouse, how it fits into the way engineering teams build and ship software, and how teams run A/B tests and feature flags. We're looking for someone who has worked with this kind of technology directly, not just alongside it, and who is as comfortable leading a customer meeting as they are working through a technical problem.

What you'll do

  • Run technical and business discovery. Understand a prospect's goals, data, tech stack and decision criteria, and shape the solution around them.

  • Build and deliver demos, presentations and prototypes tailored to each customer, for audiences from engineers to executives.

  • Lead proofs of concept hands-on, working with the customer's engineers and data teams to get Amplitude running on their own data and use cases.

  • Explain Amplitude's value to technical buyers and executives: architecture, data flows, warehouse integration, experimentation, and where it sits in a modern data stack.

  • Stay involved as customers implement. Keep the plan on track, keep technical stakeholders aligned, and make sure what we proposed gets delivered.

  • Be proactive. Follow up quickly, build relationships across the customer's technical team, and keep deals moving without waiting to be asked.

  • Act as the voice of the market inside Amplitude: bring customer feedback and requirements back to Product, and help AEs, Customer Success and newer teammates with the technical side.

  • Travel within the region to meet customers when needed.

What you'll bring

  • 6-8+ years of Senior-level experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting.

  • Hands-on technical and data skills. You can build a sample app for a demo, instrument SDKs and feature flags, and troubleshoot customer questions.

  • Hands-on technical experience with two or more of the following:

    • Experimentation: designing and running A/B tests, feature flags and controlled rollouts.

    • Software development lifecycle: how engineering teams plan, build, test and release software, and where analytics, gates and experimentation fit in.

    • Data warehousing: working with cloud data warehouses, including connecting, modelling and activating data. Experience at a data warehouse or data platform company is especially relevant.

    • Modern data stack architecture: designing how collection, storage, transformation and analytics tools fit together.

    • AI: harnesses, evals, governance

  • Strong demo building. You create demos and presentations that make a product real for a specific audience.

  • Solid discovery skills. You ask the questions that uncover what a customer needs and how they'll make their decision.

  • The ability to explain value clearly to technical buyers, from engineering and data leaders to the business stakeholders they work with.

  • You're based in Singapore and comfortable covering customers across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan.

  • A background in developer tooling.

  • Implementation, post-sales or consulting experience where you owned multi-month customer projects and managed technical stakeholders.

  • A second language used across the region.

  • Ensure that all tickets meet our service level agreements

    • Including an on-call weekend support once per quarter and voluntary on-call holiday support

  • Work closely with Customer Success Managers to drive data trust in key accounts

  • Provide customers a great experience using Amplitude and working with our team

  • Create and update non-technical and technical documentation as the product evolves

  • Report to the company any common themes or questions that arise and driving change

  • Develop and improve support processes

  • Experience with using SDKs and APIs, experimentation, stats, or data science

  • Track record in a similar customer-facing role OR strong ability to empathize with customers and be their advocate

  • Experience working with data pipelines or warehouse ingestion (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar) — including debugging data freshness and backfill issues

  • Comfort interpreting and explaining statistical outputs to customers with varying levels of technical sophistication

  • The ability to present yourself with professionalism, friendliness, and a willingness to assist

  • Ability to learn and explain a technical product or concept

  • Natural curiosity and are a problem solver

  • Passion about analytics and the problems they solve

  • Familiarity with Support tools such as Zendesk, Intercom, Confluence, and Linear

  • Familiarity with statistical experimentation concepts; A/B testing, p-values, confidence intervals, and sequential testing methods (e.g. SPRT)

  • Ability to reason through metric design issues including outlier handling techniques such as winsorization, and their effect on experiment results

Please Note: This role is a non-exempt role and will require you to be in the Amplitude New York office at least 3 times a week.

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), home office equipment (annual), and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12-20 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Counsel, Commercial to play a key role on our Legal team, supporting our global go-to-market organization and advising on the commercial relationships that drive our business. You’ll own complex, high-value negotiations with enterprise customers, partners, and vendors, bringing practical legal guidance and sound business judgment to agreements involving SaaS, professional services, data privacy, and procurement. Working closely with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders, you’ll help teams navigate competing priorities, resolve challenging contract issues, and make informed decisions that balance growth with legal and business risk. Beyond individual transactions, you’ll help shape how commercial legal support scales at Amplitude by strengthening templates, improving contracting workflows, and equipping teams with the training and tools to move forward confidently.

As a Sr. Counsel, Commercial, you will:

  • Lead commercial negotiations: Draft, review, and negotiate strategic customer and partner agreements, including SaaS agreements, professional services agreements, data processing agreements, and nondisclosure agreements, and support responses to RFPs.

  • Support vendor relationships: Structure and negotiate inbound vendor agreements, partnering with internal stakeholders to address business needs and manage legal risk.

  • Advise our go-to-market teams: Provide practical guidance on commercial terms, contracting issues, and risk mitigation, balancing legal considerations with business priorities.

  • Make contracting more efficient: Partner with Sales and Finance leadership to improve self-service resources, commercial negotiation workflows, and contract lifecycle management. Maintain and update templates as our products, business, and applicable laws evolve.

  • Build knowledge across the business: Develop training and resources on contracting processes, key negotiation issues, data privacy, and relevant compliance requirements so teams can make informed decisions and move deals forward.

You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:

  • You bring experience supporting a B2B SaaS company and understand the needs of a global go-to-market organization.

  • You take a practical, solutions-oriented approach and help teams find a path forward through complex negotiations.

  • You work effectively through ambiguity, take initiative, and adapt as priorities change.

  • You build strong relationships, welcome different perspectives, and collaborate well while independently owning your work.

  • You’re interested in using AI tools thoughtfully to streamline legal workflows and improve efficiency.

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • You have a JD and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.

  • You bring 5-12 years of experience negotiating commercial agreements through a combination of in-house and law firm roles.

  • You have strong drafting and negotiation skills, with experience independently managing complex commercial transactions.

  • You demonstrate sound business judgment and can assess legal risk in the context of commercial goals.

  • You communicate clearly and translate complex legal issues into practical guidance for people without a legal background.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Salesforce Engineer specializing in Quote-to-Cash to build and evolve the systems behind how we sell, contract, and provision customers. You’ll write production code, develop integrations, and improve the reliability of our existing workflows while delivering changes that support new products, commercial models, and business growth.

As part of GTM Engineering, you’ll partner with Sales Finance, Sales, and Product & Engineering to translate business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. Your work will span recurring CPQ defects, customer provisioning, acquisition-related contracting changes, and the evolution of our Quote-to-Cash architecture.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain Quote-to-Cash solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow, choosing code or configuration based on the problem.

  • Build and extend CPQ capabilities for product launches, pricing, bundling, discount approvals, subscriptions, amendments, and renewals.

  • Diagnose complex quoting, contracting, order, and entitlement defects; trace failures through code, data, and integrations; and implement root-cause fixes with regression tests.

  • Partner directly with Sales Finance and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess tradeoffs, estimate effort, and own delivery from technical design through production validation.

  • Develop contract and subscription data models that support acquisition requirements, multiple contracts per customer, and flexible contract start dates.

  • Partner with EPD Growth to resolve provisioning discrepancies and build reliable provisioning and deprovisioning workflows so customer access matches purchased entitlements.

  • Write bulk-safe, maintainable code with meaningful automated tests; participate in code reviews and deliver changes through version control and the team’s release process.

  • Reduce recurring operational work through automation, improved validation, and targeted fixes that prevent repeat deal escalations and manual data corrections.

  • Build and maintain APIs and integrations connecting Salesforce with contracting, billing, and product-provisioning systems, including error handling, retries, and reconciliation.

  • Document technical designs, data flows, and operational behavior; partner with business users on acceptance testing and validate downstream outcomes after release.

  • Contribute to Quote-to-Cash transformation, including CPQ migration, new currencies and commercial models, and integration of acquired products.

  • Evaluate changes to CPQ and related Salesforce capabilities and recommend improvements that simplify the architecture and reduce ongoing maintenance.

Your First Six Months of Impact

  • Independently deliver Quote-to-Cash enhancements and resolve complex defects, with tested changes and clear ownership of downstream outcomes.

  • Identify recurring quoting and contracting problems, establish a baseline for repeat escalations, and ship fixes that reduce manual intervention.

  • Partner with EPD Growth to address priority provisioning failure modes and improve visibility into entitlement mismatches and failed handoffs.

  • Deliver an agreed milestone on the Quote-to-Cash roadmap, such as acquisition-related contracting, provisioning automation, or CPQ migration readiness.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including production ownership of Salesforce CPQ and Quote-to-Cash solutions.

  • Deep understanding of CPQ product configuration, pricing rules, quote calculations, subscriptions, amendments, renewals, and the quote-to-contract-to-order lifecycle.

  • Strong Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, and Salesforce Flow skills, with experience building bulk-safe solutions, asynchronous processing, and meaningful automated tests.

  • Experience designing and debugging API integrations, including authentication, error handling, retries, and data consistency across connected systems.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into technical designs and explain tradeoffs to Sales, Finance, and engineering partners.

  • Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and regression testing, with evidence of independently shipping and supporting reliable production changes.

  • A track record of tracing complex defects to root cause and improving existing systems; a degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I/II or CPQ credentials, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

  • Experience with SaaS billing, revenue processes, entitlements, customer provisioning, or acquisition-related systems integration.

  • Experience migrating CPQ platforms or implementing multi-contract architectures, multicurrency selling, or flexible subscription terms.

  • Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve engineering productivity and reduce recurring Quote-to-Cash support work.

Why This Role

Your work will directly shape how Amplitude brings products to market and delivers purchased capabilities to customers. You’ll combine hands-on development with ownership of complex Quote-to-Cash problems, reducing the maintenance burden on the team and helping deliver the next generation of our commercial systems.
